_comment: Runtime configuration converged on for PYNQ-Z1 (dual-core Cortex-A9 @ 650 MHz). Values are the measured optimum from the parameter sweep in paper section 8.2, not defaults.

session._inter_op_note: more than 1 parallel stream only added scheduling overhead
session._session_note: session construction costs 100-300 ms; build once and reuse

inference._batch_note: large batches keep NEON vector lanes busy; dropping to 64 costs ~35% throughput but cuts per-image latency to ~5 ms

quantization._qoperator_note: QOperator is 10-20% faster than QDQ on this target
quantization._calibration_note: 256 was the empirical optimum for this dataset
